text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even the voices of the cicadas past their 
prime, ah, seem to mourn their parting 
with us...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless, "The Show must go on"! From 
here on out, we are a quartet!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is right around the 
corner! Are you ready, Doto?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll be Opera O-san's rival at the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn) too! ...I mean, I will!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to Ayabe-san or Top 
Road-saaaan...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...You're free to get fired up all you 
want, but really, I'd appreciate it if you 
didn't drag me into your bizarre 
spectacles."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um. Opera O and the others are 
really good friends, aren't they! Ahaha.
